question: Mr. Z starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the North. He then takes a left turn, drives 19 km, then turns left and drives 30 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 21 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 16 km, and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Mr. Z starts from Point A and drives 14 km towards the North.

He then takes a left turn, drives 19 km, then turns left and drives 30 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 21 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 16 km, and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef5e2fc2b3f889749632d33e50c4e222edaab0ea788dec53f73b6a77ec994119.png] 

So, he should drive 2 km to the west in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
